routineModal.title: Title
routineModal.titleHint: Write it as the job, not the schedule.
routineModal.dayOfMonthHint: A 31st routine lands on the last day of a shorter month rather than skipping it.
routineModal.relativeHint: Negative counts backwards — -14 means two weeks before opening day.
routineModal.noSeasonToCount: No season is set yet, so there is nothing to count from.
routineModal.onTurnoverHint: Raised whenever a session or rental group departs.
routineModal.noAssetTracksHours: No asset is tracking hours yet. Turn that on for the machine in Assets & Vehicles first — this routine has nothing to count against until you do.
routineModal.noAssetTracksMiles: No asset is tracking miles yet. Turn that on for the machine in Assets & Vehicles first — this routine has nothing to count against until you do.
routineModal.dueAnyTime: Leave blank for any time that day.
routineModal.startingFromHint: The date the count runs from.
routineModal.meterPreview: Comes due on a reading, not a date.
routineModal.nothingDue: Nothing comes due in the next five years. Check the window and start date.
routineModal.activeWindowHint: Without a window, this keeps raising work all year.
routineModal.raiseAhead: Raise it this many days ahead
routineModal.countFromHint: "Finished" suits jobs measured from the last service — an oil change three weeks late should push the next one back, not stay on the old grid.
routineModal.pauseHint: Stops new occurrences. Anything already raised stays in the queue.

problems.title: Give the routine a title — it becomes the work order title.
problems.meterAsset: A meter routine has to count against a specific asset.
problems.meterInterval: Set how many hours or miles between occurrences.
problems.noSeason: There is no season yet, so "relative to opening day" has no day to count from.
problems.windowBackwards: The active window ends before it starts.

routines.nothingWasDue: Nothing was due. Every routine has either already been raised or is not due yet.

routines.raised_other: Raised {{count}} work orders. They are in the queue now.
routines.openStillOpen: the open one is still open
routines.nothingOpen: nothing is open — Generate now will raise the next one
routines.emptyBody: Set a cadence once and it lands in the queue as a real work order.
routines.closeOpenOne: Close the open one and the next appears.
routines.noOccurrenceOpen: No occurrence is open. Generate now will raise the one that is due.

checklists.heading: Checklists
checklists.lede: Ticking the last step closes the work order.
checklists.emptyBody: A cabin turnover, a bathhouse round, a vehicle pre-trip — whatever your crew actually does, in your words.
checklists.noSteps: Nothing yet. Add the first step below.
checklists.retireHint: Hides it from the pickers. Work orders that already have its steps keep them.

automatic.heading: Automatic checklists
automatic.lede: Some work orders raise themselves. Pick which of your checklists each one starts from, or leave it as none — the job still lists every room it covers either way.
automatic.writeFirst: Write a checklist below first, then you can point one of these at it.
automatic.space_setup_when: When you approve a group’s request for a room.
automatic.space_reset_when: Raised with the set-up, due the day after the group leaves.
automatic.room_turnover_when: When a rental group departs, and at the end of a camp session.

vendors.emptyBody: The septic pumper, the well contractor, the elevator inspector.
vendors.crewHint: Whose work they turn up for.
vendors.notesPlaceholder: Two weeks' notice in August. Invoices net 30.
vendors.inactive: We do not use them any more
vendors.inactiveHint: Hides them from the dispatch picker. History keeps their name.

calendar.tooWide: That is {{days}} days. A timeline that wide is a wall of colour rather than something you can read a week off — narrow it to a season or less.

calendar.noTurnovers: No turnover days in this window.

review.failedTitle: The review could not be built
review.failedBody: That did not come back. Try again.
review.confirmBody: Stores these numbers so they cannot change later. Leave the date blank for today, or set it to rebuild the board as it stood then — useful in November for a season that closed in August.
review.costsNote: Counts, closures and ageing rebuild to that date. Recorded costs do not — nothing keeps a history of what was typed into them, so they read as they are today.
review.releaseTitle: Delete this snapshot. The live review is unaffected.
review.frozen: Frozen snapshot — the board as it stood on {{asOf}}. Saved {{saved}}. It will not change.
review.frozenBy: Frozen snapshot — the board as it stood on {{asOf}}. Saved {{saved}} by {{name}}. It will not change.
review.actionFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed — try again.
